title: betula glandulosa var. glandulifera
intro: Betula glandulosa var. glandulifera, commonly known as Japanese Birch, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce pain, fever, and inflammation, as well as boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Japanese Birch include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Japanese Birch include betulin, betulonic acid, and other triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
